title: DSA Mastery
tagline: A 30-day loop you run every month until the patterns are muscle memory.

ranks.name: Cold Start
ranks.note: Day one of the loop. Everything is a lookup.

ranks.name: Warming Up
ranks.note: You recognise the shapes. You still reach for the template.

ranks.name: Screen Ready
ranks.note: Phone screen problems come out clean, first try.

ranks.name: Onsite Ready
ranks.note: You pick the pattern before you finish reading the prompt.

ranks.name: L4 Ready
ranks.note: Template is gone. You just write the solution.

ranks.name: Muscle Memory
ranks.note: This is the point of the whole thing.
